summary.text: Pearl Beckage is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Chittenden-23 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Essex resident and educator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on fiscal discipline, lower taxes and returning decision-making to the local level.

paragraphs.text: Beckage said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Vermont since 2003 and is a longtime Essex resident.
She said she was born into a military family and moved 14 times during her childhood, and that her professional life has centered on supporting young learners and families.
She described her community service as including mentoring children in public schools and providing care and companionship to the elderly.
Beckage said she decided to run because of rising living costs, higher property taxes, growing state spending and burdensome regulations.

She listed her policy priorities as responsible state budgeting, affordability for Vermont families, high-quality education with careful use of taxpayer dollars, reduced regulation, and government transparency and accountability.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
